title: ServerMessage
description: Neuro Observatory EEG stream protocol v2: messages sent by the neuro-engine to stream consumers. Canonical, language-neutral source of truth (ADR-0008).

SchemaVersion.description: Protocol major version. Incremented on any breaking change.

StreamId.description: Identifier of one continuous acquisition stream. A new value is issued whenever continuity cannot be guaranteed (start, reconnect).

Counter.description: Non-negative integer within the JSON/JavaScript safe-integer range.

MonotonicMicroseconds.description: Engine monotonic clock reading in microseconds. Arbitrary epoch; only differences and the stream anchor are meaningful.

firmwareVersion.description: Device firmware version when reported by the device.

SyntheticProvenance.title: SyntheticProvenance
SyntheticProvenance.description: Signal is generated by software. It is not a measurement of any person.

configHash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical generator configuration.

DeviceProvenance.title: DeviceProvenance
DeviceProvenance.description: Signal was measured by a physical acquisition device.

index.description: Zero-based row index of this channel in EegBlock.samples. Must equal the channel's position in the channels array.

label.description: Channel label, e.g. a 10-20 electrode name. Unique within a stream.

unit.description: Physical unit of sample values. 'uV' = microvolts.

reference.description: Electrical reference of the channel (e.g. 'SRB2'), or 'synthetic' for generated signals.

ClockAnchor.title: ClockAnchor
ClockAnchor.description: Simultaneous readings of the engine monotonic clock and the host UTC wall clock, captured when the stream opened.

timestampSource.description: What firstSampleTimeUs represents. 'synthetic-nominal': exact by construction, no real latency. 'host-receipt-fitted': host receipt times fitted against device counters. 'device-clock': device-provided time mapped to the engine clock.

StreamMetadata.title: StreamMetadata
StreamMetadata.description: Describes a stream. Sent first on every connection while a stream is open (otherwise stream.status comes first) and whenever a new stream starts.

nominalSampleRateHz.description: Declared sampling rate. Actual timing is described by the timebase; the engine never resamples.

EegBlock.title: EegBlock
EegBlock.description: A contiguous block of samples for all channels of a stream.

blockSequence.description: Per-stream block counter assigned by the engine, starting at 0. A jump indicates blocks dropped in transport.

firstSampleIndex.description: Per-stream index of samples[*][0]. Sample i of this block has index firstSampleIndex + i.

sampleCount.description: Number of samples per channel in this block.

firstSampleTimeUs.description: Estimated acquisition time of the first sample on the engine monotonic clock. Sample i is at firstSampleTimeUs + i * 1e6 / nominalSampleRateHz.

droppedSamplesBefore.description: Samples lost during acquisition immediately before this block. Missing samples are never fabricated.

samples.description: Channel-major sample values in each channel's declared unit.

samplesAcquired.description: Samples per channel accepted from the device in the current stream.

acquisitionGapSamples.description: Samples missing from the device in the current stream.

rejectedBlocks.description: Device blocks rejected as malformed, duplicate or out-of-order in the current stream.

blocksDroppedForClient.description: Blocks dropped for this connection because it consumed too slowly.

effectiveSampleRateHz.description: Sample-index advance per second of engine monotonic time between the first and the latest accepted device block of the current stream (includes acquisition gaps), or null until that span is at least one second.

StreamStatus.title: StreamStatus
StreamStatus.description: Periodic acquisition status and counters for one connection.

streamId.description: Current stream, or null when no stream is open.

error.description: Most recent acquisition error, or null.
